description: Enhanced boundary coverage for ELLIPSE reads (native-disjoint). The native suite only reads a bare ellipse; this populates the center, a +Y major-axis endpoint, a fractional minor-to-major axis ratio (group 40) and a partial parameter sweep (start 41 = 0, end 42 = pi) so the non-default ratio and end parameter are observable.

cases.expected_output:
type=ellipse
layer=0
linetype=BYLAYER
linetype_scale=1
is_visible=true
is_in_paper_space=false
color=BYLAYER
center=1,2,0
major_axis=0,1,0
normal=0,0,1
minor_axis_ratio=0.5
start_parameter=0
end_parameter=3.14159
